topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer biology
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the course structure, target audience, and key learning outcomes for the lecture series.

topics.label: Cancer as a stepwise failure of differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cumulative genetic changes disrupt normal developmental programs, tissue architecture, and cellular differentiation.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and stepwise tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how tumors progress from contained, benign precursor states into invasive and metastatic malignancies using histological criteria and the colorectal model.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the conventions for naming tumor types and the physiological mechanisms by which tumors cause illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across tissues and species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine epidemiological patterns of tumor incidence in humans and compare cancer occurrence across different animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and clinical practices of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, diagnostic methods, and efficacy of population screening programs for detecting pre-malignant and malignant lesions across various organs.
